Shanghai Municipal Police. （印：整 22）
CENTRAL Station.
Sept. 22 1922
REPORT ON Former offices of Labour Secretariat unsealed
Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by W. Givens A.S.
Sir,
A room at No. 196 Chengtu Road which was formerly
used as the offices of the Labour Secretariat, and which
was sealed up by order of the Mixed Court on July 17, 1922,
was unsealed on Sept. 22, 1922. The petition to unseal
the premises was made by Messrs Ellis & Hays and granted
by Mr. Blackburn, British Assessor, on Sept. 8, 1922 on
condition that the Police be allowed to take possession of
any papers that may be found on the premises. The condition
was, however, unnecessary as a thorough search of the
premises were made when the sealing order was executed.
The tenant of the house at the time the sealing order was
executed, one Tsang Tsen Jien (湯載其), a sorter employed
at the Nanking Road branch of the Chinese Post Office,
has since been turned out by the landlord and the new tenant
has been informed that if any part of the premises are in
future let to any undesirable person or society the conse-
quences will be serious.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D. I. Sullivan.
D. I.
Forwarded
Biemaidi
for D. O. I.
All

中央捕房。
1922年9月22日
关于启封前劳工书记处办公处的报告
由 D. I. Sullivan 呈报，经 W. Givens 助理总监转发

先生：

位于成都路196号的一间房间，此前曾用作劳工书记处的办公处，并已于1922年7月17日根据会审公廨的命令予以查封，现于1922年9月22日启封。启封该处所的申请由 Ellis & Hays 律师行提出，并于1922年9月8日获英籍陪审官 Blackburn 先生批准，条件是允许警方接管在该处所内发现的任何文件。然而，此条件实属多余，因为在执行查封令时已对该处所进行了彻底搜查。

在执行查封令时，该房屋的租户为汤载其（Tsang Tsen Jien），系中国邮政局南京路支局的分拣员。此后，他已被房东驱逐，且新房客已被告知，若将来将该处所的任何部分出租给任何不良分子或社团，后果将十分严重。

先生，
您顺从的仆人，
D. I. Sullivan.
督察

转发
Biemaidi
代副总监
致所有相关人员

CENTRAL Station.
July 15 192 2

REPORT ON Search of 19c Chengtu Road

Made by D. I. Sullivan Forwarded by J.H. Chivers D.I.

Sir,

The headquarters of the Labour Secretariat, 19c
Chengtu Road, were searched on a Mixed Court Warrant, by
D. I.'s Sullivan and Kay and Chinese Interpreters Zau Sz Sing
and Yao Yoong Zu on July 12. Seventy two copies of a leaflet
entitled "An Appeal by the International Committee of the
Red Labour Unions to the Chinese Workmen", the language of which
is considered to be of a violent nature and likely to provoke
a breach of the peace were discovered. A quantity of printed
matter bearing on the conviction of Li Chi Han, the Macao
incident, Chinese Bolshevism, Lists of Labour Unions and also a
large number of addresses to which the "Labourers Weekly"
was formerly posted were discovered and seized. A number of
old copies of the newspaper "Labourers Weekly", the publication
of which was ordered to be suppressed by Mr. Blackburn, British
Assessor, at the Mixed Court on June 9, were also seized.
All the handbills, leaflets, newspapers etc. seized refer to
events in the labour and political worlds.

Since the conviction of Li Chi Han (李之漢), the
house is occupied by one Taung Tsen Jien (湯載其), a sorter
employed at the Nanking Road branch of the Chinese Post Office.
He sublets one room to Toong Tsu Bing (董鈿年) who is now
acting as secretary to the Labour Secretariat.

I respectfully beg to suggest that an application be
made to the Mixed Court for the room at No. 19c Chengtu Road
to be sealed up. This would necessitate the occupant of the
house either applying to the Mixed Court for the seals to be
removed or vacating the house. If the former course is adopted

1922年7月15日

关于搜查成都路19c号的报告

由 D. I. Sullivan 呈报，经 J.H. Chivers 督察转发

先生：

7月12日，根据会审公廨的搜查令，由督察 Sullivan 和 Kay 以及中文翻译赵四兴（Zau Sz Sing，音译）和姚永祖（Yao Yoong Zu，音译）对位于成都路19c号的劳工书记处总部进行了搜查。发现了七十二份题为《红色工会国际委员会告中国工人书》的传单，其语言被认为具有暴力性质，可能引发破坏和平的行为。还发现并扣押了大量涉及李之汉定罪案、澳门事件、中国布尔什维克主义、工会名单的文件，以及大量此前寄送《劳工周刊》的地址列表。此外，还扣押了多份旧版《劳工周刊》，该刊物的出版已于6月9日由英籍陪审官 Blackburn 先生在会审公廨下令查禁。所有被扣押的传单、小册子、报纸等均涉及劳工界和政治界的事件。

自李之汉（Li Chi Han）被定罪以来，该房屋由汤载其（Taung Tsen Jien）居住，他是中国邮政局南京路支局的分拣员。他将其中一个房间转租给董鈿年（Toong Tsu Bing，音译），此人目前担任劳工书记处的秘书。

本人谨建议向会审公廨申请查封成都路19c号的房间。这将迫使房屋 occupant（居住者/租户）要么向会审公廨申请解封，要么搬离该房屋。如果采取前者

Translation by Inter. Yao of Circular Received
by Local Labour Unions and believed to Emanate
from the Labour Secretariat, No. 19c Chongtu Road.
----------
An appeal by The International Committee
of "Red" Labour Unions to the Chinese Workmen.

Comrades !
The echoes of your recent brave struggles
against Chinese and foreign plunderers in Hongkong,
Canton and other places have reached our ears.
Chinese workers, your condition is very miserable.
You are being maltreated by two classes of oppressors,
viz, the armed foreign capitalists of the modern
industrial world and Chinese employers of labour.
Why have Americans, Britishers and Japanese come
to China ? Their object is to make enormous
profits by the sweat of Chinese workmen and poor
people, their own countries being too small to
contain these robbers. These men who are but a
portion of those who survived the European War,
now contemplate recovering their enormous loss
during the war by adopting oppressive tactics,
to plunder the Chinese and other Asiatic peoples.
Their words are sweet but concealed in
their pockets are dangerous arms and under their
arms cannons and aeroplanes. They are using every
aggressive means to plunder your nation, they are
devouring one province after another like silk
worms feeding on mulberry leaves. They are
compelling you to work for low wages which,
when compared can not even exceed one per cent
of the wages paid to the female and child labourers
in their own countries. Chinese industrial
labourers are giving up their blood and sweat
in order to increase the vast riches of the
European and American capitalists who have constructed
many railways and established innumerable factories
in your country, their object being to reap the
profits for themselves and to transform you into
slaves and machinery. Such are the "most fair"
plans of democratic America and "law-abiding"
Britain and Japan in China. The men who plunder
your persons are not labourers. They belong to
the wealthy class eager to amass vast fortunes
and who do not know what to do with their wealth.
Protected by cannons and rifles foreigners have
forcibly brought their money into China, built
railways and established factories, and made use
of the Chinese poor classes as part of their
machinery. They have also taken advantage of the
chaotic conditions of labour in China to train up the
workers and to make use of them later on. In modern
factories thousands of your brothers are working
together. You have already had a good idea of
your strength. In many of your strikes you have
well demonstrated your ability to make use of
your strength and organization. You have adopted
the right plan. There is no other possible way
of escaping the aggression of the capitalists except
by struggling against both Chinese and foreign

由翻译 Yao 翻译的通告，该通告由当地各工会收到，据信发自位于崇途路（Chongtu Road，原文如此，应为成都路 Chengtu Road）19c号的劳工书记处。
----------
“红色”工会国际委员会告中国工人书

同志们！
你们最近在香港、广州及其他地方反抗中外掠夺者的英勇斗争的回声，已传入我们的耳中。
中国工人们，你们的处境非常悲惨。
你们正遭受两类压迫者的虐待，即现代工业世界的武装外国资本家和中国雇主。
美国人、英国人和日本人为什么来到中国？他们的目的是通过榨取中国工人和穷人的血汗来获取巨额利润，因为他们本国的土地太小，容不下这些强盗。这些人只是欧洲大战幸存者中的一部分，现在正企图通过采取压迫性策略，掠夺中国人和其他亚洲人民，以弥补他们在战争期间的巨大损失。
他们的话语甜蜜，但口袋里藏着危险的武器，臂膀下夹着大炮和飞机。他们正使用一切侵略手段来掠夺你们的国家，像蚕吃桑叶一样，一个省接一个省地吞噬。他们强迫你们低薪工作，相比之下，甚至不及他们本国女工和童工工资的百分之一。中国产业工人正在献出他们的血汗，以增加欧美资本家的巨大财富，这些资本家在你们国家修建了许多铁路，建立了无数工厂，其目的是为自己攫取利润，并将你们变成奴隶和机器。这就是民主的美国、“守法”的英国和日本在中国的“最公平”的计划。
掠夺你们人身的人不是劳动者。他们属于渴望积累巨额财富且不知如何处置这些财富的富裕阶级。在炮舰和步枪的保护下，外国人强行将资金带入中国，修建铁路，建立工厂，并利用中国贫困阶级作为其机器的一部分。他们还利用中国劳工混乱的状况来训练工人，以便日后加以利用。在现代工厂里，成千上万的兄弟在一起工作。你们已经对自己的力量有了很好的认识。在许多罢工中，你们很好地展示了利用自身力量和组织的能力。你们采取了正确的计划。除了同时反抗中外

pages.en:
financiers. In the fight against the wealthy
class you must give up such thoughts as race,
religion and nationality. The police of your coun-
try obey only the orders of the foreign capitalists.
There is only one remedy and that is to unite
in one organization in opposing the Chinese
and foreign employers. In the recent struggle
between you and the British, American, Chinese,
Japanese and French shipowners in Hongkong and
Canton, the "front lines" (real intention)
of both parties were clearly revealed and their
faces unmasked. Some of the members of the
Seamen's Union were arrested at the requests
of the foreign capitalists, and the strikes in
other parts of China were suppressed. The
Chinese and foreign capitalists are working
hand in hand against you !
For Many years ago the capitalists had already
combined and formed a battle line. They have
established their own international organization
to exploit the poor. In all countries except
in Soviet Russia, you will find that the
constitutions, laws, police and all other legis-
lations have been framed to protect the "private
estate system" and to oppress the poor labouring
masses. The recent European war was not only
did not destroy the international organization
of the capitalists, but gave birth to various
groups of them. Germany stood up alone, but
England and France formed another party. Events
also have shown that when faced with labour
problems the capitalists of a nation with one mind,
immediately work in combination to oppose the
labouring class. The capitalists want to secure
control of the working classes. When capitalists
fear that anything liable to endanger their
interests, they will immediately make preparations
to suppress it. Their unanimity in using arms to
oppose Soviet Russia was not by any means sudden
or unexpected. They had prepared for this
because Soviet Russia had destroyed the private
estate system, had unlocked the handcuffs of the
poor and had foiled the plans all they have
around their hearts.
The International Committee of "Red" Labour
Unions requests you, the Chinese labourers to
join the international family of the revolutionary
proletariat. The committee so urges you because
you are the victims of the exploiters and of the
two oppressors, the Chinese and the foreign
capitalists. The Committee sincerely hopes you
will become their affectionate brothers and
expects you to unite and come into line with
the workers of the whole world in order to
carry on the struggle against capitalism. The
Committee knows very well that you have to endure
suffering and hardship: that is unavoidable in
any labour movement. You have taken the first
step. You have already organized a great number
of labour unions which have already experienced
much hardship and you have been given a demonstration
of unity in your ranks. You have also shown that
pages.zh:
金融家外，没有其他可能的途径来逃避资本家的侵略。在与富裕阶级的斗争中，你们必须放弃种族、宗教和国籍等观念。你们国家的警察只听从外国资本家的命令。唯一的补救办法就是联合成一个组织，反对中外雇主。在最近你们与香港和广州的英、美、中、日、法船东的斗争中，双方的“前线”（真实意图）清晰显露，他们的面目也被揭穿。一些海员工会的成员应外国资本家的要求被捕，中国其他地区的罢工遭到镇压。中外资本家正联手对付你们！
多年前，资本家就已经联合起来形成了战线。他们建立了自己的国际组织来剥削穷人。除苏维埃俄罗斯外的所有国家，你们都会发现，宪法、法律、警察和所有其他立法都是为了保护“私有财产制度”并压迫贫困劳动大众而制定的。最近的欧洲战争不仅没有摧毁资本家的国际组织，反而催生了各种资本家集团。德国独自站立，但英国和法国组成了另一派。事件也表明，当面临劳工问题时，一个国家的资本家会同心协力，立即联合起来反对劳动阶级。资本家想要控制工人阶级。当资本家担心任何可能危及其利益的事情时，他们会立即准备予以镇压。他们一致使用武力反对苏维埃俄罗斯绝非突然或意外之举。他们为此做了准备，因为苏维埃俄罗斯摧毁了私有财产制度，解开了穷人的枷锁，挫败了他们心中盘算的所有计划。
“红色”工会国际委员会请求你们，中国劳动者，加入革命无产阶级的国际大家庭。委员会如此敦促你们，因为你们是剥削者以及中外资本家这两类压迫者的受害者。委员会真诚地希望你们成为他们亲爱的兄弟，并期望你们团结起来，与全世界的工人保持一致，以继续进行反对资本主义的斗争。委员会非常清楚，你们必须忍受痛苦和艰辛：这在任何劳工运动中都是不可避免的。你们已经迈出了第一步。你们已经组织了许多工会，这些工会已经经历了许多艰辛，并且你们在队伍中展现了团结。你们还表明了

pages.en:
you are able to fight the capitalists. The
International Committee of "Red" Labour Unions
has already hoisted the flag calling for a world
revolution against capitalism, and now requests
you, our brothers in distant China, to join
the family of the proletariat. There is only
one chance for labourers to secure victory and
that time is when revolution breaks out and a
powerful international organization is created.
This will then be a good opportunity for all
workers, from Canton to San Francisco, from
Tokyo to Stockholm, from Moscow to London, and
for all those who are being oppressed, exploited
and plundered.
    We congratulate you, the Chinese proletariat
and the poor workers !
    The International Committee of "Red" Labour
Unions requests you to join their battle line
in order to begin a unanimous fight for victory.
    Long live the Chinese revolutionary workers !
    Oppose your own and foreign plunderers !
    Call out loudly for a revolution of world
workers !

                        Losovsky,
                        Chairman, Executive Committee of the
                        International Committee of "Red"
                        Labour Unions.

Moscow, May 8, 1925.
pages.zh:
你们有能力对抗资本家。“红色”工会国际委员会已经高举号召世界革命反对资本主义的旗帜，现在请求你们，我们在遥远中国的兄弟们，加入无产阶级的大家庭。劳动者获得胜利的机会只有一次，那就是革命爆发并建立一个强大的国际组织的时候。这将是所有工人，从广州到旧金山，从东京到斯德哥尔摩，从莫斯科到伦敦，以及所有受压迫、受剥削和受掠夺的人的好机会。
    我们祝贺你们，中国无产阶级和贫困工人！
    “红色”工会国际委员会请求你们加入他们的战线，以便开始为胜利而进行一致的斗争。
    中国革命工人万岁！
    反对你们自己和外国的掠夺者！
    大声呼吁世界工人的革命！

                        洛佐夫斯基（Losovsky），
                        “红色”工会国际委员会执行委员会主席

莫斯科，1925年5月8日。

IN THE INTERNATIONAL MIXED COURT AT SHANGHAI
CRIMINAL JURISDICTION

To the Commissioner of Police Shanghai and other
officers of this Court

Complaint has this day been made by
the Commissioner
of the Shanghai Municipal Police that whereas it is suspected and
believed that copies of hand bills in respect
of which an offence has been
committed are concealed
in premises No. 19 C. Chengtu Road
Contrary to Article 221 of the Chinese Provisional
Criminal Code, and the aforesaid complainant having applied for a
Search Warrant to enter the said premises to search for and detain
the said hand bills
and it appears to this Court that such a search as prayed for should
be made. You are therefore hereby authorized with proper assistance
to enter premises No. 19 C. Chengtu Road
and there diligently to search for the said hand bills
and if the same or any thereof are found on search to bring the

1922 年 7 月 20 日

上海公共租界会审公廨
刑事管辖权

致上海警务处处长及本法庭其他官员

兹有上海工部局警务处处长于今日提出控告，称据怀疑并相信，涉及已发生罪行之传单副本藏匿于成都路（Chengtu Road）中 19 号 premises 内，此举违反《中华民国暂行新刑律》第 221 条；鉴于上述控告人已申请搜查令，以便进入所述处所搜查并扣押所述传单，且本法庭认为应当进行所请求之搜查。因此，特此授权你们在适当协助下，进入成都路（Chengtu Road）中 19 号处所，并在该处勤勉搜查所述传单；若在搜查中发现所述传单或其任何部分，应将所获传单呈交本法庭，以便依法处理。

西捕房辖区。1922 年 7 月 10 日。

劳工秘书处办公室
待搜查。
1922 年 7 月 17 日 Ew. Thm.
